identity.title: Elizabeth Oldfield & James Marriott: Is God the answer to our Meaning Crisis? | Uncommon Ground

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

participants.basis: Brierley introduces topics, poses questions, summarizes the guests, and sometimes presses Marriott with leading formulations, but he does not sustain a separately scored case. Oldfield alone develops the God-grounded relational and spiritual account; Marriott alone develops the ultimate-meaninglessness and humanly generated meaning account. The assessed window begins with Oldfield's first substantive answer and ends with her final reflection. The opening montage, introductory logistics, mid-roll promotion, and host outro are excluded.
